voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Jack - Deep Dark Horror Narrator (BVPhWQykET1TSvfGzrUr), English, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.45 s, atempo 1.0

lines.text: Watch the chair. Not the bed. The chair.
lines.beat_before: hook: the dark back bedroom from a tripod; the chair by the window; two beds; the landing light through the door

lines.text: Enfield, north London. August, nineteen seventy-seven. A council house. A mother, and four children.
lines.beat_before: a car passes outside: its headlights sweep the ceiling through the curtains

lines.text: It started with knocking. Inside the walls.
lines.beat_before: the clock on the wall; breathing under a blanket

lines.text: A police officer came, at about one in the morning. She said she watched a chair slide across the floor. By itself.
lines.beat_before: three knocks inside the wall above the far bed; the picture frame jumps; then the first tape dropout: the chair is nearer the bed

lines.text: Investigators taped this house for over a year. On the tapes, knocks seem to answer questions.
lines.beat_before: the clock now reads one o clock

lines.text: And there is a voice. A deep, old man's voice. It came from one of the girls.
lines.beat_before: knocks answer: one, then a pause, then two; a shadow crosses the landing light; second dropout: the chair nearer, turning

lines.text: Skeptics said the children faked it. Years later, one of the girls said they had faked a little. Once or twice.
lines.beat_before: a low rasp from the far bed, too low to make out; the blanket there does not rise; third dropout: the chair at the foot of the bed, facing it

lines.text: You were watching the chair. Weren't you?
lines.beat_before: silence: even the room tone drops; nothing moves for too long
